name: Source Inspector (ob inspect requirement)
description: Playable lab adaptation of the operation subset ob consumes for its inspect role, with the settled kinds model. Retains the complete referenced schema graph; not a published shared interface revision.

kind.description: Kind identifier, exact and opaque (e.g., example.openapi@1, example.mcp@1).

Source.description: A complete OpenBindings 0.2 source, forwarded by value. Its exact kind governs its content.

Operation.description: Potential OpenBindings operation framing for a bindable target.

BindableTarget.description: A target admitted by the source's governing kind that can be framed as an OpenBindings operation. Any included framing is a sound projection of this same target.

selector.description: Selector string a conforming binding entry can use under the governing kind.

operationKey.description: Suggested operation key for this target.

SourceInspection.description: Inspection result for a binding source artifact. Its inventory boundary is the targets admitted by the governing kind, not every interaction in the upstream artifact.

exhaustive.description: True when targets is the complete list of targets admitted by the governing kind. False means more admitted targets may exist and requires limitation evidence.

InspectionLimitation.description: Machine-readable evidence explaining why a source inspection is not exhaustive.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of what may be missing and why.

details.description: Optional implementation- or family-specific structured evidence.

KindVerdict.description: Authoritative support verdict for one exact kind identifier. Future optional fields may annotate this verdict but never qualify or soften supported.

kind.description: Exact kind identifier token as supplied by the caller.

supported.description: Strict support verdict. True warrants that this implementation implements the specification denoted by the exact kind string, as published; false is an unqualified refusal.

openbindings.source-inspector.listSuppor.description: List the kinds this inspector can inspect, by exact identifier.

openbindings.interface-synthesizer.check.description: Authoritatively determine support for exact, opaque kind identifier tokens. This is the only operation a consumer may use to make a support decision such as source acceptance, refusal, or delegation. The result contains one verdict per unique input token in first-occurrence order. supported is always a strict boolean; true warrants that this implementation implements the specification the exact string denotes, as published. The result is deterministic for a given implementation version and the operation is side-effect free. An internal pattern may compress the warranted set but MUST NOT extend it: an implementation never answers true for a specification it has not implemented and never matches future revisions by prefix or regular expression. Future optional verdict fields may annotate a verdict but never qualify or soften supported.

kinds.description: Exact, opaque kind identifier tokens to check. The array may be empty.

openbindings.source-inspector.inspectSou.description: Inspect a binding source artifact and return targets admitted by its governing kind, optionally with sound operation framing. The result states whether enumeration is exhaustive and explains any partial result.
